_meta.about: All class, coach, schedule and price data for the Group Fitness concept. Times are Bali time (Asia/Makassar, UTC+8). Prices in IDR. Anything with "sample": true (or listed in "sample_fields") is a placeholder and is marked Sample on the page.

sources.prices: elitefitbali.com/promo-duo/ and /membership/, 27 Oct 2026; class passes from /membership/, 2 Oct 2026
sources.classes: elitefitbali.com/schedule/<class>/ pages, 1 Oct 2026; descriptions rewritten in the club's voice, facts unchanged

club.name: Elite Fit Bali

whatsapp.open_item: The /promo-duo/ page uses a second number, +62 851-9552-0220. Confirm which one the club wants.

class_rules: Arrive at least 10 minutes before the class.
Cancel in advance so someone else can take your spot.
If nobody has arrived 15 minutes after the start, the class is called off.
club.booking_today: Members book in the GymMaster app or at the front desk. Non-members can join through ClassPass.
bring: Towel, showers and lockers at the club

families.name: Boxing
families.feel: Gloves on, no contact. Rey calls the rounds and the room keeps the rhythm.

families.name: Conditioning
families.feel: HYROX-style circuits and off-court work. You'll leave out of breath and in good company.

families.name: Sculpt
families.feel: Glutes, core and full-body strength, at a steady pace.

families.name: Mobility & Stretch
families.feel: The slow hour your body has been asking for.

classes.name: HYROX Conditioning
classes.description: Rey's take on the HYROX race format: an hour of HIIT, functional moves and endurance work for all-round fitness.

classes.name: Off-Court Training
classes.description: Rey built this one for racket players, then opened it to everyone. Strength work, explosive moves and cardio to lift your game and help prevent injuries.

classes.name: Boxercise Beginner
classes.description: Boxing training with no contact, led by Rey: strength, speed, agility and endurance. It's a fun class, open to most fitness levels and recommended from age 14.

classes.name: Boxercise Advanced
classes.description: Boxing training with no contact, led by Rey: strength, speed, agility and endurance. This is the advanced version of the class, recommended from age 14.

classes.name: Booty and Core
classes.description: Icha's hour for glutes and abs. Strength, flexibility and endurance, set up so beginners and regulars can train side by side.

classes.name: Body Sculpt
classes.description: A 60-minute full-body class with Icha: strength moves mixed with cardio to lift your heart rate and build muscle.

classes.name: Stretching
classes.description: An hour of guided stretching with Ain.

classes.name: Injury Prevention & Mobility
classes.description: Mobility work with Tinos to keep you moving well.
classes.source: https://elitefitbali.com/class-schedule/ (new on 27 Oct, page not read)
classes.length_note: Checked 27 Oct 2026: the live timetable prints start times only (Mon 13:00, Wed 10:00, Thu 10:00) and the class has no page yet. Every other class page says '1 hour training', so 60 min is assumed and marked Sample.

coaches.name: Rey
coaches.role: Sports Strength & Conditioning · Weight loss · 1:1 Boxing
coaches.bio: Rey built the boxing, HYROX and off-court classes. Every weekday starts with one of his.

coaches.name: Tinos
coaches.bio: Tinos brings careful mobility work to the timetable three times a week.

coaches.name: Ain
coaches.bio: If you train at the weekend, you'll train with Ain.

coaches.name: Icha
coaches.bio: Icha's hours are built around glutes, abs and full-body strength.

coaches_not_shown.name: Reski
coaches_not_shown.why: Shown on handbook p. 21 and in Aldy's design, but not on the club's trainer grid or the 27 Oct timetable. Left out until the club confirms.

coaches_not_shown.name: Putu
coaches_not_shown.why: On the club's trainer grid but teaches none of the timetable classes.

timetable.weekend_note: Weekend classes run on set dates. Check the GymMaster app or ask at the front desk.
timetable.open_item: Thursday's first class is printed '8:00 am 8:30 am'; 08:30 follows the 1 Oct timetable.

spots.note: The club publishes no capacity or spots left. The page makes stable sample numbers from the class and date; about one class in eight shows as full so the waitlist can be seen.

member.name: I'm a member
member.note: Perform and Elite memberships include every class.

day.name: Day Pass
day.note: Every class that day, plus the gym floor and the outdoor area.

duo.name: Duo Day Pass
duo.note: Two Elite day passes: classes, gym, pool, ice bath, sauna and café.
duo.credit_note: Decide to join after? We'll credit your day pass toward your membership.

packs.name: Perform, 4 weeks
packs.note: Gym, outdoor area and every class.

packs.name: Elite, 4 weeks
packs.source: https://elitefitbali.com/promo-duo/ (27 Oct 2026); badge from handbook p. 22 and the club's 'Most Popular' label

payment_methods.note: Demo only. The club's tools today: GymMaster (members), ClassPass (non-members), Moka (shop).

review.author: Skye D.S.
review.text: A welcoming, laid-back space with genuinely friendly people and a restaurant worth staying for. It feels less like a gym and more like a community.
review.source: Google review, shown on elitefitbali.com/promo-duo/ (27 Oct 2026)
